复习: 证明技巧总表
Review: Proof Techniques Summary Table

Slide 2
To prove that this is true…
∀x. AHave the reader pick an arbitrary x. We then prove A is true for that choice of x.
∃x. AFind an x where A is true. Then prove that A is true for that specific choice of x.
A→BAssume A is true, then prove B is true.
A∧BProve A. Then prove B.
A∨BEither prove ¬A→B or prove ¬B→A. (Why does this work?)
A↔BProve A→B and B→A.
¬ASimplify the negation, then consult this table on the result.

We'll refer to this several times today to help us write proofs. You'll find that although you've never written proofs about Functions before, it's just the same bag of tricks that we're used to!

这张表把前几讲的证法按一阶公式的形状汇总: 要证的命题最外层是什么符号, 证明就按对应的一行来写.

  • ∀: 让读者任取, 再证. ∃: 自己找出一个, 再验证.
  • →: 假设前件, 证后件. ∧: 两边分别证.
  • ∨: 证 ¬A→B 即可. 为什么: ¬A→B≡¬¬A∨B≡A∨B. 直觉是「如果 A 不成立, 那就看 B 是否成立」.
  • ↔: 两个方向各证一次. ¬: 先把否定推进去化简, 再按化简后的形状查表.

今天讲函数, 虽然是新对象, 证明用的还是这同一套方法.

Slide 3

Outline for Today

  • What is a Function?
    • It's more nuanced than you might expect.
  • Domains and Codomains
    • Where functions start, and where functions end.
  • Defining a Function
    • Expressing transformations compactly.
  • Special Classes of Functions
    • Useful types of functions you'll encounter IRL.
  • Proofs on First-Order Definitions
    • A key skill.

这一讲给函数下正式定义 (定义域、陪域、确定性), 再看对合、单射、满射三类特殊函数. 重点是最后一项: 把这些性质的一阶定义直接当作证明的骨架.

什么是函数
What is a function?

Slide 5–7

In high school math:

f(x)=x4−5x2+4 — Take a real number as input, give a real number as output.

In C++ coding:

int flipUntil(int n) {
    int numHeads = 0;
    int numTries = 0;
    while (numHeads < n) {
        if (randomBoolean()) {
            numHeads++;
        }
        numTries++;
    }
    return numTries;
}

Take input(s) of different type(s). Return an output of some type.

In logic, functions are deterministic. That is, given the same input, a function must always produce the same output.

In C++ code, we can use random numbers, but that would not be a valid function under our definition.

「函数」在不同地方意思不同. 中学数学里, 函数输入一个实数, 输出一个实数. 编程里, 函数可以接收各种类型的输入, 返回某种类型的输出; 例子 flipUntil(n) 不断抛硬币, 直到抛出 n 次正面, 返回总共抛了几次.

逻辑里的函数要求 deterministic 确定性: 同样的输入必须永远得到同样的输出. flipUntil 用了随机数, 同一个 n 每次调用结果可能不同, 所以按本课的定义它不是函数.

Slide 8

Domains and Codomains

  • Every function f has two sets associated with it: its domain and its codomain.
  • A function f can only be applied to elements of its domain. For all x in the domain, f(x) belongs to the codomain.

The function must be defined for every element of the domain. The output of the function must always be in the codomain, but not all elements of the codomain must be produced as outputs.

每个函数 f 带着两个集合: domain 定义域 (允许的输入) 和 codomain 陪域 (输出所在的集合). f 只能作用在定义域的元素上, 输出一定落在陪域里.

读图的两个要点: 定义域里每个元素都必须有箭头射出 (函数在整个定义域上有定义); 陪域里的元素不必都被箭头指到 (陪域可以比实际输出多).

易错: 陪域不是值域. 实际被取到的输出组成的集合叫 range 值域 (或像), 它是陪域的子集.

Slide 9–10 
double absoluteValueOf(double x) {
    if (x >= 0) {
        return x;
    } else {
        return -x;
    }
}

The domain of this function is R. Any real number can be provided as input.

The codomain of this function is R. Everything produced is a real number, but not all real numbers can be produced.

If f is a function whose domain is A and whose codomain is B, we write f:A→B.

Think of this like a “function prototype” in C++.

B f(A arg);   f:A→B — Codomain, Function name, Domain

绝对值函数: 定义域是 ℝ (任何实数都能输入), 陪域也是 ℝ (输出都是实数), 但负数永远不会被输出. 这说明陪域可以比实际输出大.

记法 f:A→B 表示「f 的定义域是 A, 陪域是 B」, 相当于 C++ 的函数原型 B f(A arg);: 返回类型对应陪域, 参数类型对应定义域. 注意这里的 → 不是逻辑蕴含, 只是函数类型的写法.

Slide 11–13

The Official Rules for Functions

  • Formally speaking, we say that f:A→B if the following two rules hold.
  • First, f must be obey its domain/codomain rules:

    ∀a∈A. ∃b∈B. f(a)=b
    (“Every input in A maps to some output in B.”)

  • Second, f must be deterministic:

    ∀a1​∈A. ∀a2​∈A. (a1​=a2​→f(a1​)=f(a2​))
    (“Equal inputs produce equal outputs.”)

If you're ever curious about whether something is a valid function, look back at these rules to decide. The formal definition holds the answers!

Can a function have an empty domain?

正式定义: f:A→B 要满足两条规则.

  1. 定义域/陪域规则: 每个 a∈A 都有某个 b∈B 使 f(a)=b. 也就是每个输入都映射到 B 中某个输出.
  2. 确定性: 若 a1​=a2​, 则 f(a1​)=f(a2​). 相等的输入给出相等的输出.

拿不准某个东西是不是函数时, 就逐条检查这两条.

课堂提问「函数的定义域可以是空集吗?」答案: 可以. A 为空时两条规则都是「对 A 中所有元素 …」, 在空集上空真. 这样的函数叫空函数, 对任何陪域 B 都恰好有一个.

原文笔误: “f must be obey its domain/codomain rules” 多了 be, 应为 “f must obey”.

定义函数
Defining Functions

Slide 15–17
  • To define a function, you need to
    • specify the domain,
    • specify the codomain, and
    • give a rule used to evaluate the function.
  • All three pieces are necessary.
  • There are a few ways to do this. Let's go over a few examples.

Usually these are handled by using the f:A→B notation.

Functions can be defined as a picture.

(图: 左边椭圆里是三张鸟的照片, 右边椭圆里是四个鸟名 Anna's Hummingbird、White-Tailed Kite、Red-Shouldered Hawk、Goldfinch; 每张照片有一条箭头指向它的名字, Goldfinch 没有被指到.)

Draw sets (ovals) to give the domain and codomain. Draw a mapping (arrows) to define the function's action.

定义一个函数要给出三样东西: 定义域、陪域、计算规则, 缺一不可. 前两样通常用 f:A→B 一次写出.

第一种定义方式是画图: 用椭圆表示定义域和陪域, 用箭头表示每个输入映射到哪个输出. 例子把三张鸟的照片映射到鸟名; 陪域里的 Goldfinch 没有照片指向它, 这完全允许.

Slide 18–19

Functions can be defined as a rule.

f:Z→Z, where f(x)=x2+3x−15

Use the : notation to name the domain and codomain. Use the f(x)= notation to define the function's action.

Some rules are given piecewise.

f:Z→N, where f(n)={n−n​amp;if n≥0amp;if n≤0​

Again, both parts of the rule (: and f(x)) are necessary. Make sure at least one condition applies to each element of the domain, and that if more than one condition applies to the same element, they give the same answer!)

第二种方式是写规则 (公式): 用冒号记法给出定义域和陪域, 再用 f(x)=… 给出计算方法. 第一个例子在整数上算 x2+3x−15, 结果仍是整数, 所以陪域写 ℤ 没问题.

规则可以分段给出. 第二个例子是绝对值, 写成 Z→N (输出都非负). 分段时要检查两件事:

  • 定义域每个元素至少满足一个条件 (这里 n≥0 和 n≤0 覆盖了所有整数).
  • 如果某个元素同时满足多个条件, 各段给出的结果要一样. 这里 n = 0 同时满足两段, 结果 0 和 −0 相同, 所以没问题. 否则就违反了确定性.

一些细节
Some Nuances

Slide 21–24

f(x)=x+1x+2​

Quick Check: If introduced as f:N→R, would this be a valid function?

Yep, it's a function! Every natural number maps to some real number.

Quick Check: If introduced as f:R→R, would this be a valid function?

This expression isn't defined when x=−1, so f isn't defined over its full domain. We therefore don't consider it to be a function.

同一个式子是不是函数, 要看给定的定义域和陪域.

  • 作为 N→R: 自然数都 ≥0, 分母 x+1≥1 不会为 0, 每个输入都得到一个实数, 是函数.
  • 作为 R→R: x = −1 时分母为 0, 式子无定义, 违反「每个输入都有输出」, 不是函数.

这说明定义域和陪域是函数的一部分, 不是可有可无的说明.

Slide 25

Is this a function from A to B?

不是. 每所大学都有两条箭头 (两种校色), 例如 Stanford 同时指向 Cardinal 和 White. 同一个输入对应两个输出, 违反了确定性规则.

Slide 26

Is this a function from A to B?

也不是. 前三个州各自正确指向首府, 但 Washington DC 没有任何箭头, 定义域里有一个元素没有输出, 违反了第一条规则. 修正方法: 把 Washington DC 从定义域里去掉, 或在陪域里给它一个输出.

特殊函数: 对合
Special Types of Functions: Involutions

Slide 28–31

(插图: 一个房间的灯, 按一次开关灯灭, 再按一次灯又亮.)

Undoing by Doing Again

  • Some operations invert themselves. For example:
    • Flipping a switch twice is the same as not flipping it at all.
    • In first-order logic, ¬¬A is equivalent to A.
    • In algebra, −(−x)=x.
    • In set theory, (AΔB)ΔB=A. (Yes, really!)
  • Operations with these properties are surprisingly useful in CS theory and come up in a bunch of contexts.
    • Storing compressed approximations of sets (XOR filters).
    • Theoretically unbreakable encryption (one-time pads).
    • Transmitting a large file to multiple receivers (fountain codes).

有些操作做两次就回到原样: 开关按两次等于没按; 双重否定 ¬¬A≡A; 取两次相反数 −(−x)=x; 对称差两次 (AΔB)ΔB=A.

最后一个可以这样理解: 对称差就是「属于 B 的元素状态翻转一下」(在 A 里就删掉, 不在就加上), 翻两次回到原样. 这和按位异或 XOR 是同一回事, 所以它在计算机里很有用: XOR 过滤器、一次一密加密 (明文 XOR 密钥得密文, 密文再 XOR 同一密钥得明文)、喷泉码.

Slide 32

Involutions

A function f:A→A (notice this requires the domain and codomain to be the same set) is called an involution if the following first-order logic statement is true about f:

∀x∈A. f(f(x))=x.

(“Applying f twice is equivalent to not applying f at all.”)

Involutions have lots of interesting properties. Let's explore them and see what we can find.

函数 f:A→A 如果满足 ∀x∈A. f(f(x))=x, 就叫 involution 对合: 作用两次等于没作用. 定义域和陪域必须是同一个集合, 否则 f(f(x)) 里外层的 f 可能无法作用在 f(x) 上.

Slide 33–44

Which of the following are involutions?

  • f:Z→Z defined as f(x)=x. Yep!
  • f:Z→Z defined as f(x)=−x. Yep!
  • f:R→R defined as f(x)=1/x. Not a function!
  • f:N→N defined as follows: f(n)={n+1n−1​amp;if n is evenamp;if n is odd​ Yep!

Select the number of involutions (0-4) on PollEv.

f:R−{0}→R−{0} defined as f(x)=1/x. Yep!

答案是 3 个.

  • 恒等函数 f(x)=x: f(f(x))=x, 是对合.
  • 取相反数: −(−x)=x, 是.
  • 1/x 作为 R→R: 在 0 处无定义, 根本不是函数. 把 0 从定义域和陪域里都去掉, 1/(1/x)=x, 就是对合.
  • 分段函数: 偶数加 1, 奇数减 1, 也就是 0↔1、2↔3、4↔5 两两交换. 交换两次回到原位, 是对合. 注意 0 是偶数, 映射到 1, 不会出现 −1, 所以陪域 ℕ 没问题.
Slide 45–46

Involutions, Visually

A function f:A→A is called an involution if the following first-order logic statement is true about f: ∀x∈A. f(f(x))=x.

读图: 把定义域和陪域画成同一个椭圆后, 对合的箭头只有两种形状: 两个元素互相指向 (一对交换), 或者一个元素指向自己 (不动点). 不会出现 a → b → c 这样的链, 因为那样 f(f(a))=c=a.

关于对合的证明
Proofs on Involutions

Slide 48–64

Theorem: The function f:Z→Z defined as f(n)={n+1n−1​amp;if n is evenamp;if n is odd​ is an involution.

For this problem, we will rely on two facts we will call Lemma 1 and Lemma 2 (“Lemma” just means theorem, but is used to label theorems we only use to help prove more important theorems, so like a “helper theorem”), which you can assume are true, for this problem only:

Lemma 1: For all integers n, n is even if and only if n+1 is odd.
Lemma 2: For all integers n, n is odd if and only if n−1 is even.

What does it mean for f to be an involution? ∀n∈Z. f(f(n))=n. Therefore, we'll have the reader pick some n∈Z, then argue that f(f(n))=n.

Proof: Pick some n∈Z. We need to show that f(f(n))=n. To do so, we consider two cases.

Case 1: n is even. Then f(n)=n+1, which is odd, by Lemma 1. This means that f(f(n))=f(n+1)=(n+1)−1=n.

Case 2: n is odd. Then f(n)=n−1, which is even, by Lemma 2. Then we see that f(f(n))=f(n−1)=(n−1)+1=n.

In either case, we see that f(f(n))=n, which is what we need to show. ■

!! Important style rule !! This proof contains no first-order logic syntax (quantifiers, connectives, etc.). It's written in plain English, just as usual.

证明分三步思考:

  1. 写出要证性质的一阶定义: ∀n∈Z. f(f(n))=n.
  2. 按最外层符号查表: ∀ → 让读者任取 n, 证 f(f(n))=n.
  3. f 是分段定义的, 自然按奇偶分情况. 偶数 n: 先加 1 得奇数 (引理 1), 奇数再减 1 回到 n. 奇数 n: 先减 1 得偶数 (引理 2), 再加 1 回到 n.

lemma 引理就是定理, 只是专门用来辅助证明更重要的定理. 两个引理在本题里可以直接用.

重要的写作规则: 一阶定义只用来规划证明的结构, 证明本身用普通英语写, 不出现 ∀、→ 之类的符号. 小测问用了表里哪一行: ∀ 那一行 (任取 n).

幻灯片错误: 这个定理里 f 的定义域是 ℤ, 但 Slide 48–55 的证明第一句写成 “Pick some n ∈ ℕ”, 只覆盖了自然数. Slide 56 起改成 “Pick some n ∈ ℤ”, 上面按改正后的版本照录.

Slide 66–72

Theorem: The function f:N→N defined as f(n)=n2 is not an involution.

What does it mean for f to be an involution? ∀n∈N. f(f(n))=n.

What is the negation of this statement?
¬∀n∈N. f(f(n))=n
∃n∈N. ¬(f(f(n))=n)
∃n∈N. f(f(n))=n

Therefore, we need to pick some concrete choice of n such that f(f(n))=n.

Proof: We need to show that there is some n∈N where f(f(n))=n.

Pick n=2. Then

f(f(n))​amp;=f(f(2))amp;=f(4)amp;=16,​

which means that f(f(n))=2, as required. ■

要证「不是对合」, 先把定义取否定: 「对所有 n, f(f(n))=n」的否定是「存在 n, f(f(n))=n」. 存在命题 → 自己找一个具体的 n. 取 n = 2: f(f(2))=f(4)=16=2.

易错: n 不能随便挑. n = 0 时 f(f(0))=0, n = 1 时 f(f(1))=1, 这两个都不是反例. 找反例时要先在草稿上试. 小测的答案: 先用 ¬ 行化简否定, 再用 ∃ 行.

单射
Injective Functions

Slide 75–76

Injective Functions

  • A function f:A→B is called injective (or one-to-one) if the following statement is true about f:

    ∀a1​∈A. ∀a2​∈A. (a1​=a2​→f(a1​)=f(a2​))
    (“If the inputs are different, the outputs are different.”)

  • The following first-order definition is equivalent (why?) and is often useful in proofs.

    ∀a1​∈A. ∀a2​∈A. (f(a1​)=f(a2​)→a1​=a2​)
    (“If the outputs are the same, the inputs are the same.”)

  • A function with this property is called an injection.
  • How does this compare to our second rule for functions?

函数 f 是 injective 单射 (也叫一对一), 指不同的输入给出不同的输出. 图里每个行星符号指向不同的行星名, 没有两条箭头指向同一个名字; Earth 没被指到也无妨.

两种等价的一阶定义, 第二种是第一种的逆否: 「输入不同 → 输出不同」等价于「输出相同 → 输入相同」. 证明时第二种常更好用, 因为可以从等式出发做代数.

和函数的第二条规则 (确定性) 比较: 确定性是「输入相同 → 输出相同」, 单射是「输出相同 → 输入相同」, 方向正好相反. 每个函数都满足前者, 只有单射满足后者.

Slide 77–82

Injections

Let 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 be the set of all CS103 students. Which of the following are injective?

  • f:🧑‍🤝‍🧑→N where f(x) is x's Stanford ID number. ✔
  • f:🧑‍🤝‍🧑→🌎, where 🌎 is the set of all countries and f(x) is x's country of birth. ❌
  • f:🧑‍🤝‍🧑→💬, where 💬 is the set of all given (first) names, where f(x) is x's given (first) name. ❌

Select the number of injective functions (0-3) on PollEv.

答案 1 个. 学号每人唯一, 不同学生学号不同, 是单射. 出生国家: 两个同学可以生在同一国, 不是单射. 名字: 两个同学可以同名, 也不是. 要说明「不是单射」, 只需举出两个不同的人有同样的输出.

Slide 83–97

Theorem: Let f:N→N be defined as f(n)=2n+7. Then f is injective.

What does it mean for the function f to be injective?
∀n1​∈N. ∀n2​∈N. (f(n1​)=f(n2​)→n1​=n2​)
∀n1​∈N. ∀n2​∈N. (n1​=n2​→f(n1​)=f(n2​))

Therefore, we'll pick arbitrary n1​,n2​∈N, assume f(n1​)=f(n2​), then prove that n1​=n2​.

Proof: Consider any n1​,n2​∈N where f(n1​)=f(n2​). We will prove that n1​=n2​.

Since f(n1​)=f(n2​), we see that

2n1​+7=2n2​+7.

This in turn means that

2n1​=2n2​,

so n1​=n2​, as required. ■

Good exercise: Repeat this proof using the other definition of injectivity!

用第二种定义 (「输出相同 → 输入相同」) 规划: 两个 ∀ → 任取 n1​,n2​; 一个 → → 假设 f(n1​)=f(n2​), 证 n1​=n2​. 正文只是解方程: 两边减 7 再除以 2.

课件留的练习: 用第一种定义证. 任取 n1​=n2​, 要证 2n1​+7=2n2​+7. 可以用反证: 若相等, 则如上推出 n1​=n2​, 与假设矛盾. 可见第一种定义绕了一圈, 这就是为什么第二种「在证明中常更有用」.

幻灯片前后不一致: Slide 83–84 的证明用变量 n0​,n1​, 而 Slide 85 的一阶定义又在 n0​,n1​ 和 n1​,n2​ 之间混用; 从 Slide 92 起统一成 n1​,n2​. 上面按统一后的版本照录. 只是换名, 不影响论证.

Slide 99–111

Theorem: Let f:Z→N be defined as f(x)=x4. Then f is not injective.

What does it mean for f to be injective? ∀x1​∈Z. ∀x2​∈Z. (x1​=x2​→f(x1​)=f(x2​))

What is the negation of this statement?
¬∀x1​∈Z. ∀x2​∈Z. (x1​=x2​→f(x1​)=f(x2​))
∃x1​∈Z. ¬∀x2​∈Z. (x1​=x2​→f(x1​)=f(x2​))
∃x1​∈Z. ∃x2​∈Z. ¬(x1​=x2​→f(x1​)=f(x2​))
∃x1​∈Z. ∃x2​∈Z. (x1​=x2​∧¬(f(x1​)=f(x2​)))
∃x1​∈Z. ∃x2​∈Z. (x1​=x2​∧f(x1​)=f(x2​))

Therefore, we need to find x1​,x2​∈Z such that x1​=x2​, but f(x1​)=f(x2​). Can we do that?

Proof: We will prove that there exist integers x1​ and x2​ such that x1​=x2​, but f(x1​)=f(x2​).

Let x1​=−1 and x2​=+1. Notice that

f(x1​)=f(−1)=(−1)4=1

and

f(x2​)=f(1)=14=1,

so f(x1​)=f(x2​) even though x1​=x2​, as required. ■

证「不是单射」: 把单射的定义逐步取否定, 两个 ∀ 变两个 ∃, → 的否定变 ∧, 得到「存在 x1​=x2​ 使 f(x1​)=f(x2​)」. 存在命题 → 给出具体值: −1 和 1 不同, 四次方都是 1.

这是「先求否定, 再查表」的标准流程: ¬ 行把否定化简成 ∃∃(…∧…), 再用 ∃ 行和 ∧ 行.

幻灯片前后不一致: Slide 99–105 的证明里, 第一句写 “integers x₁ and x₂”, 后面却用 x0​=−1、x1​=+1; Slide 106 起统一成 x1​,x2​. 上面按统一后的版本照录.

满射
Surjective Functions

Slide 114–115

Surjective Functions

  • A function f:A→B is called surjective (or onto) if this first-order logic statement is true about f:

    ∀b∈B. ∃a∈A. f(a)=b
    (“For every output, there's an input that produces it.”)

  • A function with this property is called a surjection.
  • How does this compare to our first rule of functions?

函数 f 是 surjective 满射 (也叫映上), 指陪域里每个元素都至少被一个输入取到. 图里每个州都有箭头指入, 所以是满射; 但多座火山指向同一个州, 所以不是单射.

和函数第一条规则比较: 规则一是 ∀a∈A. ∃b∈B (每个输入都有输出), 满射是 ∀b∈B. ∃a∈A (每个输出都有输入), 角色互换. 每个函数都满足前者, 只有满射满足后者.

Slide 116–130

Theorem: Let f:R→R be defined as f(x)=2x. Then f(x) is surjective.

What does it mean for f to be surjective? ∀y∈R. ∃x∈R. f(x)=y

Therefore, we'll choose an arbitrary y∈R, then prove that there is some x∈R where f(x)=y.

Proof: Consider any y∈R. We will prove that there is a choice of x∈R such that f(x)=y.

Let x=y/2. Then we see that

f(x)=f(y/2)=2y/2=y.

So f(x)=y, as required. ■

满射的定义是 ∀y. ∃x: 先让读者任取 y, 你再根据 y 选出 x. 这就是上一讲「∀∃ 里 x 可以依赖 y」的体现. 要 2x=y, 解出 x=y/2; y 是实数, y/2 也是实数, 在定义域里.

易错: 同样的函数如果定义成 Z→Z 就不是满射, 因为奇数 y 的 y/2 不是整数.

幻灯片错误: Slide 116–121 的证明写 “Let x = 2y. Then we see that f(x) = f(2y) = 2y / 2 = y.” 这是错的: f(x) = 2x, 所以 f(2y) = 4y, 而且 2y / 2 也对不上 f 的定义. 应取 x = y / 2, 这时 f(y / 2) = 2y / 2 = y. Slide 122 起已改正, 上面按改正后的版本照录.

幻灯片小错: 定理写 “Then f(x) is surjective”, f(x) 是一个值, 满射的应是函数 f, 应写 “Then f is surjective”. Slide 132 的 “Then g(x) is not surjective” 同理.

Slide 132–142

Theorem: Let g:N→N be defined as g(n)=2n. Then g(x) is not surjective.

What does it mean for g to be surjective? ∀n∈N. ∃m∈N. g(m)=n

What is the negation of the above statement?
¬∀n∈N. ∃m∈N. g(m)=n
∃n∈N. ¬∃m∈N. g(m)=n
∃n∈N. ∀m∈N. g(m)=n

Therefore, we need to find a natural number n where, regardless of which m we pick, we have g(m)=n.

Proof: Let n=137. Now, pick an arbitrary m∈N. We need to show that g(m)=n.

Notice that g(m)=2m is even, while 137 is odd. Therefore, we have g(m)=137, as required. ■

Our overall goal is to prove ∃n∈N. ∀m∈N. g(m)=n. We just made our choice of n. Therefore, we need to prove ∀m∈N. g(m)=n. We'll therefore pick an arbitrary m∈N, then prove that g(m)=n.

否定满射定义得到 ∃n. ∀m. g(m)=n: 找一个永远不被取到的输出. 两层量词依次处理:

  1. ∃n: 你选 n = 137 (任何奇数都行).
  2. ∀m: 读者任取 m, 你证 2m=137. 理由: 2m 是偶数, 137 是奇数, 没有整数既奇又偶.

这个例子显示了嵌套量词的证明结构: 每剥掉一层量词, 就按表里对应一行处理剩下的式子.

幻灯片前后不一致: Slide 132 的证明第一版写 “We will show there is a natural number n such that g(m) ≠ n for any m ∈ ℕ. Let n = 137. We must show that g(m) ≠ 137 for any m ∈ ℕ. To see this, consider some m ∈ ℕ. …”, Slide 134 起改写成上面更紧凑的版本, 两者论证相同.

Slide 144–145

Recap from Today

  • A function takes in an element of a domain and maps it to an element of a codomain. Functions must be deterministic.
  • Definitions are often given in first-order logic, and the structure of a first-order logic statement dictates the structure of a proof.
  • Involutions and injections are specific classes of functions that have nice properties.
